The '''''Blazing Torch''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] some time before a [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Dol Narlock]] served aboard before rising to the command of the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor-class'' cruiser]] [[Krakana (Valor-class)|''Krakana'']].<ref name="Narlock Codex" />
